name: K-Town Lords
description: K-Town Lords was a predominantly Hispanic street gang based on the Northwest Side of Chicago, operating near North Avenue and Kostner Avenue in the early 1970s. Members wore blue sweaters with red olympic lettering. The gang gained notoriety after fatally stabbing a 14-year-old Gaylord named Harpo on December 26, 1972. The killing triggered sustained retaliation from the Gaylords and the United Fighting Organization (UFO), ultimately leading to the gang's dissolution.
